title: Scott A NDE 947
content:
I passed out from the rush of air ( I think). I was standing on a beach naked, approximately twenty feet in front of me was another naked person, in front of him/her at the same distance another and so forth. I couldn't move my body, however I could move my eyes. I could not speak either, I couldn't move my lips. Beside me in both directions at about twenty feet were other people, and beside them others. We were all naked and unmoving unable to speak, only hear and see. The beach was endless. The most captivating part of this was that there was an ocean with waves crashing in over people, who were unable to move, and then receding to show that person was still there. The ocean was not water but fire, in the shape and appearance of water. It seemed to me that this tide was coming in. I stared at this in bewilderment, hence finding out I could not speak let alone cry out, my mind was frantic. Then to my right I noticed that there was someone moving freely, not walking but just appearing in front of some of the people there. I had noticed this person from a long way off as he seemed very small, just an silhouette, then he was in front of me. He had a kind face; grey robes; a grey head scarf like that worn by Muslims; and a whitish grey beard. He uttered no words for I did not see his mouth move, but he 'said', 'You do not belong here.' And the next instant I was flying at quite some height over the fire sea and then I awoke to find the whole school surrounding me. None of my friends would tell me what had happened but within my own mind and heart I knew that I was not with them. Since then I have had three out of body experiences, leaving no further than three feet from where I lay, from fright more than anything else. I've also seen into the near future, usually within an hour, and sometimes I get unlearned knowledge which is hard to explain.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain pushing air to brain by taking 3 huge lungfuls of air holding the last, and having someone push on your chest, hell of a rush after you woke upwoke up to find the whole school around me, which would have been difficult to achieve
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: not that i noticed but was rather young at the time
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Beings on the shore and an elder person.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: No Saw what appeared to be an oasis in the distance surrounded by trees. Just looked nice could almost say felt nice while looking at it out of the corner of my eye.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Future sight, I used to be a diver in the commercial fishing industry I could point directly at sharks and know their distance before laying eyes on them, feeling and seeing events in my mind up to a week before they occurred.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best - waking up. Worst - being there.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some believe you some don't.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: No, its all there in black and white. However, using magic mushrooms six months or so prior is the reason I went there in the first place. Also ridiculing any religion, I just didn't see any reason to believe.
